description: This file contains test cases for the validation of configuration objects related to channel webhooks and actions in a Telegram integration module. It utilizes the Vitest testing framework to verify the correctness of configuration parameters such as polling actions, webhook URLs, secrets, and ports.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite or group of related test cases.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates an assertion object used to verify test conditions.

methods.name: validateConfigObject
methods.description: Function that validates the structure and contents of a configuration object, returning an object with an 'ok' boolean and an array of 'issues' if any.
